items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: One fella named Hunts and the other fella named Nagle

ctx.x: How's that name spelled? I never get to see it
I spelled it N-E-A-G-E-L Nagle Hunts H-U-N-T-Z Nagle Yeah You see there was two partners One was named Hunts and one was named Nagle
Well I thought it was one big name
